cards.title: 事实：P1
cards.content: SnSe is a promising thermoelectric material with a ultralow lattice thermal conductivity below 1 W/mK at room temperature.

cards.title: 事实：P2
cards.content: Sn vacancies can significantly modulate the carrier concentration in SnSe, shifting the Fermi level toward the valence band.

cards.title: 事实：P3
cards.content: First-principles calculations predict a formation energy of -0.2 eV for Se vacancies, suggesting they are thermodynamically favored.

cards.title: 事实：P4
cards.content: Experimental synthesis shows severe phase separation above 5% Se vacancy concentration, inconsistent with single-phase assumptions.

cards.title: 事实：P5
cards.content: The lattice thermal conductivity of SnSe single crystals is around 0.8 W/mK at 300 K, among the lowest reported for crystalline solids.

cards.title: 事实：P6
cards.content: Sn vacancies are far less studied than Se vacancies for thermoelectric optimization, leaving a largely unexplored design space.

cards.title: 事实：P7
cards.content: Early DFT studies overestimated the stability of vacancy-ordered phases; later experiments revealed decomposition below the predicted temperatures.
